title: Nick Cannon Sends Hilarious Message To Kevin Hart
htmlContent:
Nick Cannon's phone has been ringing off the hook ever since comedian Kevin Hart posted his real number on billboards in Los Angeles, Atlanta, and New York earlier this year.

Hart shared a photo of LA's billboard on his Instagram page stating that the prank was retaliation after the "Wildin' Out" host sent a llama to Hart's home for his 42nd birthday.

Since my brother @nickcannon decided to buy me a lama for my B-Day I decided to do something nice for him as well….Here is a digital billboard in Los Angeles….I also did some in ATL & NY….if u want any advice on fatherhood, please call my BEST FRIEND @nickcannon ….I’m sure his phone has been ringing nonstop GOTCHA BACK BITCH #PRANKWARS

The ad also reads, “For any advice on fatherhood, call my best friend, Nick Cannon.” In a smaller font, it continues, “Hey guys! Here is his cell #,” adding the MTV star’s Los Angeles number for all to see."

The Wild 'N' Out host received calls from all over the world.

Well, it took Cannon nine weeks to plot and respond to Hart's joke, but it was a great one. He decided to wrap Hart's private jet with the picture from his new talk show.

MY PRANK WAR WITH KEVIN HART KEEPS US YOUNG, I took my #prankwar with @kevinhart4real to new heights! #NickCannon#NickCannonShow

According to Cannon, the prank caused Hart to miss his business trip and then tricked him into being his first guest on his new talk show 'Nick Cannon.'

"I didn't' agree to do this Nick! I had to do it!" 

If you are in Dallas, Texas Nick Cannon can be seen on KDFW at 1:00 pm CST and for other cities and states please check your local listings.
